allowed_claim_on_pass: On a previously unseen validation sample from a real randomized e-commerce experiment, Exergi's development-selected static action produced statistically supported incremental net revenue over business-as-usual after a preregistered email cost.
limitations: Hillstrom reports spend/revenue rather than contribution profit.
Observed COGS, shipping, returns, payment fees, and other variable costs are unavailable.
The declared email cost is a fixed scenario assumption, not an observed merchant cost ledger.
The proof concerns one static action in one historical randomized dataset.
